crossRefs.note: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed…
Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who…
He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
When he was thrown out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

people.name: Hebrews
people.line: An ethnic group descended from Abraham.

translations.web: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
translations.bsb: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying. So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
translations.kjv: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
translations.asv: And she opened it, and saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
